description: Repairs r-sql-2-3/act-fail-relationship: an earlier DELETE had removed parent P2. Asks the mixed case on a fresh pair of tables with no earlier DELETE: P (1, 2, 3) and C (10 -> 1, 11 -> 1, 12 -> 3) under a restrict foreign key, UPDATE C SET PID = PID + 1 without options (two children move to existing parent 2, one to missing 4); and the same on P2/C2 with dbFailOnError. RecordsAffected, Errors and the rows are read after each. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
